notes: 📱 Top 20 (and scan panels) now open FULL-PAGE on phones. The half-page behaviour was a desktop feature leaking onto mobile: panels are pushed below the Market Radar so its quick-filter chips stay tappable above them — but on a phone that upper space shows unrelated content, so the push just cost half the screen. On screens 700px and narrower the push is now off entirely and panels open as full sheets, like every other report. Desktop keeps the radar-above-panel layout.
